description.title: שינויים מהותיים
description.summary: This table outlines the insurer's rights regarding policy cancellation or liability reduction due to inaccurate or concealed information provided by the insured. It details scenarios involving incomplete answers, fraudulent intent, or failure to mitigate risks.
description.embed_passage: This table details conditions related to material changes in information provided by the insured under a car insurance policy. It outlines the insurer’s rights to cancel the policy or reduce liability if the insured provides incomplete or fraudulent answers, or fails to take stipulated risk mitigation measures. The table references the Insurance Contract Law 5741-1981. Material matters, fraudulent intent, and failure to mitigate risks are key concepts.

sketch:
38.3 If the Insured gave an answer that was not full and frank to questions regarding material matters, or concealed a material matter from the insurer with fraudulent intent, or failed to take measures stipulated by the insurer to mitigate the insured risks under the policy, the insurer may cancel the policy or reduce the scope of its liability, all in accordance with the provisions of the Insurance Contract Law 57411981 (hereinafter -the Law).
38.4 The Insured will notify the insurer during the period of insurance of any change in a material matter immediately upon learning thereof. if the insured failed to disclose such a change to the insurer, the insurer may cancel the policy or reduce the scope of its liability in accordance with the provisions of the law.
38.5 The insured shall provide the insurer, upon its request with a claims report, as defined in paragraph 52 hereunder.
